quotes.text: Bug 1895376 fixed an Extension folder API recursion bug: a virtual search folder can search its parent, so presenting its search scope as child folders makes traverseSubfolders recurse forever. getDirectSubfolders now exposes search folders as children only for unified folders. Both traversal and folders.getSubFolders pass the unified flag, and the added test asserts an ordinary search folder has zero exposed subfolders. This distinction remains in the current checkout.
